description: This file defines the Spring Data JPA repository interface OrderEntityRepository for managing OrderEntity entities, including custom query methods for retrieving orders and aggregating sales data.

classes.name: OrderEntityRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for OrderEntity providing methods for querying orders and sales data.

methods.name: findByOrderId
methods.description: Finds an order by its order ID.

methods.name: findAllByOrderByCreatedAtDesc
methods.description: Retrieves all orders ordered by creation date in descending order.

methods.name: sumSalesByDate
methods.description: Calculates the total sales (sum of grandTotal) for a specific date.

methods.name: countByOrderDate
methods.description: Counts the number of orders for a specific date.

methods.name: findRecentOrders
methods.description: Retrieves a list of recent orders with pagination support.
